sloka: तपः चरण योगार्थम् उवास सु महातपाः ।एष पूर्व आश्रमो राम वामनस्य महात्मनः ॥१-२९-३॥
transliteration: tapaḥ caraṇa yogārtham uvāsa su mahātapāḥ ।eṣa pūrva āśramo rāma vāmanasya mahātmanaḥ ॥1-29-3॥

translations.english: "O Rama this was the hermitage of glorious Vamana. The great sage her performed his ascetic pratices here, hence it is known as siddhashrama.
